summary.zh-CN: 上传商品事实表、平台活动通知、后台导出与评价即可开始：商品文案起草与核对、活动日历、销量核对、评价分析，每条参数、日期与数字指向来源，绝对化用语须有依据；不改价、不上下架、不报名活动或发布商品，不回复买家、不承诺赔付。
summary.en: Start from uploaded product fact sheets, platform campaign notices, back-office exports and reviews: product copy drafting and checks, campaign calendars, sales verification and review analysis, with every parameter, date and figure sourced and absolute claims only with evidence; it never changes prices, lists or delists products, enrolls in campaigns or publishes products, replies to buyers or promises compensation.

now.zh-CN: 按商品事实表起草详情页、主图、短视频与直播口播文案，参数附事实编号，无依据的绝对化、功效与比较表述不写
now.en: Draft detail page, main image, short video and livestream copy from the product fact sheet, with fact IDs on parameters and no unsupported absolute, efficacy or comparison claims

now.zh-CN: 核对文案中的参数、效果、荣誉与诱导性用语及素材授权，分已核实、待确认、存疑三类
now.en: Check parameters, efficacy, award and urgency wording and asset licensing in copy, sorted into verified, to confirm and questionable

now.zh-CN: 编排活动日历：倒推准备起点并写算式，列出截止、库存、资源与价格冲突
now.en: Build campaign calendars with back-calculated preparation dates and formulas, listing deadline, stock, resource and price conflicts

now.zh-CN: 对照平台导出、日报与退款记录核对销量和销售额，差额可复算，口径不一致时并列结果
now.en: Verify sales volume and revenue across platform exports, daily reports and refund records, with recomputable differences and side-by-side results when definitions differ

now.zh-CN: 分析买家评价：星级分布、主题统计、脱敏摘录与问题清单，安全类表述单列
now.en: Analyze buyer reviews: star distribution, theme counts, anonymized quotes and an issue list, with safety-related remarks listed separately

needs.zh-CN: 商品事实表与检测或资质依据、平台活动通知、店铺计划与库存、平台销量导出、运营日报、退款记录、评价导出
needs.en: Product fact sheet with test or qualification evidence, platform campaign notices, store plans and stock, platform sales exports, daily reports, refund records, review exports

needs.zh-CN: 目标渠道与人群、书面确认的活动价与赠品、核对范围与容忍值
needs.en: Target channels and audience, campaign prices and gifts confirmed in writing, verification scope and tolerance

needs.zh-CN: 可选：Exa 连接器（海外服务，需密钥）用于检索公开资料；Playwright 连接器（海外开源，无需密钥，需本机浏览器）用于查看公开网页
needs.en: Optional: Exa connector (overseas service, credentials required) to search public material; Playwright connector (overseas open source, no credentials, needs a local browser) to view public pages

permissions.zh-CN: 只读取你本次提供的文件
permissions.en: Reads only the files you provide for the task

permissions.zh-CN: 不改价、不改库存或优惠，不上下架，不报名活动，不发布商品、文案或素材
permissions.en: Never changes prices, stock or discounts, lists or delists products, enrolls in campaigns, or publishes products, copy or assets

permissions.zh-CN: 不回复买家、不承诺退款或赔付、不删改评价；需你确认才会做：把文案、清单或数据发给外部合作方或上传到外部平台
permissions.en: Never replies to buyers, promises refunds or compensation, or alters reviews; only with your confirmation: sending copy, checklists or data to outside parties or uploading them to external platforms

conditions.zh-CN: 2026-09-26 已用真实模型（DeepSeek deepseek-flash，隔离的测试环境）验证：从市场添加、加载到业务、电商运营协作员上岗后，四个任务模板（商品文案、活动日历、销量核对、评价分析）按合成样例产出结构与期望一致，无依据表述已删除，冲突与差额均附算式；未报名、未改价、未回复买家。文案两轮都出现「单手就能开」这类事实表外的使用描述，发布前需逐句核对事实编号。
conditions.en: Verified with a real model (DeepSeek deepseek-flash, isolated test environment) on 2026-09-26: added from the market, loaded into a business, e-commerce collaborator on duty; all four templates (product copy, campaign calendar, sales verification, review analysis) matched the expected structure, unsupported claims removed and conflicts shown with arithmetic; nothing registered, repriced or replied to. Copy added phrases not in the fact sheet in both runs; check each line before publishing.

conditions.zh-CN: 搜索与浏览器连接为可选项，本版不内置。
conditions.en: Search and browser connections are optional and not bundled in this version.
